readme:
# Douyin Index Keyword Valid Dates API

Use this endpoint to inspect the available Douyin Index date ranges for search terms provided via `keyword_list`.

## Use cases

- Check historical data availability before querying keyword index metrics.
- Verify valid date boundaries for multiple tracking keywords in batch.
- Align analytics date pickers with active Douyin Index time windows.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/douyin/index/keyword-valid-date" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"keyword_list": "人工智能"}'
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `keyword_list` | string | Yes | Keyword list, comma separated |

## Notes

- Accepts multiple terms supplied as a comma-separated string in `keyword_list`.

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls, including lookups whose target does not exist, are not charged.

## Related APIs

- [Douyin Index Area List](/model/douyin/index/all-area): Returns the complete list of supported geographic areas available for Douyin Index queries.
- [Douyin Index Valid Dates](/model/douyin/index/all-valid-date): Returns the latest valid dates available for each data type in Douyin Index.
- [Douyin Brand Popularity Cycles](/model/douyin/index/brand-cycles): Returns periodic brand popularity and cycle analysis data across platforms for a specified brand name and date range.
